newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shun Tak sees HK property market rising.
newsitem.headline: Shun Tak sees HK property market rising.

text.p: Stanley Ho, chairman of Shun Tak Holdings Ltd, said on Wednesday he expected Hong Kong's property market to grow five to 10 percent in the next six months.
"I think the property market should be on the rise, but not that much. I would say five to 10 percent over a period of six months from now," Ho told reporters.
"I think all the problems concerning the (sovereignty) transition period has been resolved. So I think it will be plain sailing in six months' time from now," he added.
Hong Kong reverts to China next July 1. Political uncertainties have caused concerns over the local property market.
The company, which derives about 60 to 70 percent of its revenues from shipping business, is also engaged in property development.
"We must diversify. We can't just think of shipping. I think we have enough ships already," Ho added.
